text:
hana: quick sync — BlueHarbor wants a Private POC. Req: HSM-rooted keys + KMS-wrapped secrets + short-lived client certs from our broker. who owns presales?
peter: i'll take it. we need a concise onboarding checklist and clear transfer options. keep security in the loop early.
samir: security preference: PKCS#11 w/ vendor attestation for prod. for POC accept SCEP+OIDC or one-time CSR. require CA chain and attestation artifact if available. also ask for HSM vendor & firmware.
hana: can we list minimal artifacts we need them to upload? i'll send this to their infra lead.
peter: checklist draft: 1) CA cert chain (PEM) 2) HSM vendor/model/firmware + PKCS#11 module path OR SCEP URL + OIDC client creds 3) Key policy (non-exportable, allowed ops) 4) CSR (if manual) 5) Management plane allowlist CIDRs + bastion details 6) Bastion SSH pubkey 7) Desired cert TTL and rotation cadence 8) SIEM endpoint for audit forwarding
samir: add: PKCS#11 sign test vector (we'll provide nonce), attestation cert/quote, and SOC2/ISO evidence if they have it. also whether they want our ephemeral CA to sign POC certs (speeds onboarding).
hana: transport options to offer: (A) PKCS#11 over customer VPN (preferred), (B) SCEP + OIDC, (C) secure upload (S3 presigned PUTs w/ MFA delete or scoped SFTP). recommend A for prod; B/C ok for POC.
peter: include short example for CSR generation via PKCS#11 so they can run it and upload the CSR:
```
# on customer's HSM host
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/vendorpkcs11.so -l --keypairgen --key-type rsa:3072 --label bh_poc_key
openssl req -engine pkcs11 -keyform engine -new -key "pkcs11:object=bh_poc_key;type=private" -out blueharbor.csr -subj "/CN=blueharbor-client/O=BlueHarbor"
```
samir: what we will provide back: short-lived client certs (24h-7d per their TTL), an OCSP/CRL or revocation API, and an attestation token for the pool.
ops-bot: Ticket INF-7801 created: "blueharbor private-poc hsm+kms onboarding" — assignee: peter — due: 3 business days — https://rwd.atlassian/INF-7801
hana: timeline: request artifacts & chosen transfer method within 5 business days to hit a 2-week POC kickoff. i'll draft the kickoff email and cc security/ops.
peter: will draft email + attach checklist and PKCS#11 example. will update ticket when customer replies.
samir: security follow-ups i'll ask for: ATO statement for POC, PKCS#11 test signature, and compromise/rotation plan.
hana: thanks — i'll send initial note to BlueHarbor now and post their preference here. :rocket:
